basis: Fungal infection of scalp skin and hair follicles causing suppuration and potentially scarring alopecia; lymphadenopathy and fever do not establish additional organ damage.
Colonic and duodenal polyposis; intellectual disability and epidermoid cysts/alopecia each occur in 30-79%; retinal pigment hypertrophy is nonimpairing; iron-deficiency anemia is separate.
Immune-mediated cutaneous lichen planus with annular lesions and skin atrophy; common damaging extracutaneous involvement is not established for this variant.
Umbrella of sexually transmissible viral infections; no anatomical organ is consistently damaged across HIV, anogenital HPV infection and genital herpes.
Progressive neurological disease with myoclonus, ataxia and gait disturbance in 6/6 patients, seizures in 5/6 and cognitive deterioration in 3/6.
Malignant glial tumour originating in the spinal cord and invading neural tissue; weakness and incontinence reflect neurological injury.
Defined neonatal epilepsy syndrome; seizures usually remit in infancy with normal subsequent development.
Hallucinogen substance dependence is a psychiatric disorder; no qualifying organ damage is intrinsic to the concept.
Hereditary nail abnormality; associated short distal phalanx has no established frequency or functional damage supporting a musculoskeletal label.
Defined by constitutional thrombocytopenia and neurodevelopmental impairment; developmental delay occurs in 6/7. Isolated cardiac findings do not establish common involvement.
Xq deletions characteristically disrupt ovarian endocrine function; the broad deletion umbrella does not establish common renal, muscular or neurological damage across intervals.
Congenital atrioventricular septal defect; pancreatic involvement is not established for this specific cardiac phenotype.
Defined by intellectual disability and developmental, motor and speech delay; overgrowth and hypotonia alone do not establish endocrine or primary muscle damage.
Epithelial carcinoma originating in the ovary, a reproductive organ outside these axes; urothelial resemblance does not establish urinary involvement or endocrine dysfunction.
Progressive conjunctival pterygium; the parent concepts establish an ocular surface lesion.
Acute myeloid leukemia defined by chromosome 17p loss; malignant myeloid cells affect blood and marrow. Common additional organ damage is not established.
Progressive myoclonic neurological disease with dysarthria, spasticity and cognitive decline; Lafora bodies alone do not establish damaging involvement of other organs.
Thrombosis and inflammation of the femoral vein; neither an immune-mediated mechanism nor a primary coagulation disorder is established.
Axonal peripheral sensorimotor neuropathy; sustained denervation causes distal muscle wasting in 20/20 reported patients.
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing impairment in 15/15 patients; no additional organ involvement is established.
Spastic paraplegia with neuropathy; optic disc pallor occurs in 30-79% and reduced acuity in 3/3; distal lower-limb muscle wasting occurs in 3/3 reported patients.
Polyp occupying the rectal mucosa; no additional organ damage is intrinsic to the concept.
Primary lung malignancy with epithelial and mesenchymal components; histological composition does not establish another organ of origin.
Leukemic blood-cell neoplasm defined by infiltration of skin and subcutis despite absent detectable marrow or peripheral blood disease.
Extramedullary plasma-cell neoplasm; approximately 80% arise in upper respiratory sites, with direct local tumour infiltration. Other sites vary across patients.
